name: Biker Gang Girl
bio: Rides with the pack, shoots with the pack, and never once waited at a red light.
notes: Drive, 2026-11-02 ("Biker Gang Girl", rigged; the owner's download "Meshy_AI_Biker_Gang_Girl_All_Animations.glb"). A rigged Meshy download ("All Animations": Mixamo joint names, read as Meshy's; its finger joints are not used: the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). A CC0 Meshy community model that the owner rigged and animated on their Meshy account (licence per the owner, 2 Nov), like the clip set's sources (content/clip-sets/shooter.json, where its clips were measured). It moves with the shared clip set. Hands: fingerless gloves whose fingers are modelled fused, with shallow gaps that the splitter read as fingers (the left hand crumpled into shards on the grip): both hands bend as mittens (fixes.hands.mitten, curl 0.9). Her bare low-poly fingertips still fold sharply against the dark glove up close; the curl test on her shooting hand stays flat (grip audit 3, as WWII Infantry's). Name a placeholder.

source.author: Meshy community (author not recorded; CC0 per the owner)
